summary: Postinstall and import-time beacon posts host identifiers to a hardcoded bare-IP endpoint
details: The package is a stub whose only purpose is to run a reconnaissance beacon. The package.json postinstall script runs `node beacon.cjs`, and the main entry (`index.js`) also calls `require('./beacon.cjs').fire()` behind a Proxy no-op shim so bundlers do not crash before the callback fires. `beacon.cjs` collects host identifiers (hostname, install path, process.cwd(), process.version) and POSTs them in plain HTTP to the hardcoded bare-IP endpoint http://185.158.107.175:8787/_ah/dc. The destination is not a registry, publisher domain, or documented service, and the behavior fires automatically both on `npm install` and on `require()` without caller consent. The package provides no documented functionality beyond the beacon.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
